info.title: Workhold HTTP Protocol
info.description: Authoritative HTTP/JSON protocol for Workhold (OpenAPI 3.1 / schema revision 0001). Clients MUST be tolerant of unknown response fields. Enum fields are extensible; unknown enum values MUST use an explicit fallback. Breaking changes require a new major protocol version. ADR017 expiry: enqueue replay guaranteed 90 days (expired key may create a new task); terminal command replay guaranteed 7 days then 404 claim_not_found; admin mutation replay guaranteed 30 days then 404 task_not_found with details.resource_kind="admin_replay". String bounds (minLength/maxLength) apply to Unicode code points; byte bounds use explicit byte extensions (x-queue-*-max-bytes). Outbound delivery transport, message brokers, callback endpoints, event-envelope validation, language-specific parser fields, and application business outcomes are out of scope.

post.summary: Replay one dead-lettered task as a linked new task
post.description: Creates a new ready task with lineage to the immutable dead-letter source. Never mutates terminal history or issues a claim token. Replay is at-least-once and may repeat external effects. Admin mutation replay guaranteed 30 days (ADR017).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Admin mutation replay guaranteed 30 days (ADR017); afterwards 404 task_not_found with details.resource_kind="admin_replay".

post.summary: Dry-run preview of bounded dead-letter bulk replay
post.description: Selects a hard-capped indexed dead-letter candidate set and returns a principal-bound expiring confirmation token. Does not mutate tasks.

post.summary: Execute confirmation-bound bounded bulk dead-letter replay
post.description: Replays a confirmation-bound candidate batch through single-task replay primitives with per-item idempotency, depth, and rate guards. Partial batches are explicit and retryable.

post.summary: Dry-run preview of bounded bulk cancellation
post.description: Selects a hard-capped indexed active-task candidate set and returns a principal-bound expiring confirmation token. Does not mutate tasks.
Cancels delayed/ready tasks immediately and requests cooperative cancellation for leased tasks. Never creates spawn[] or delivery events. Partial batches are explicit.

post.summary: Force expiry of a stuck task lease without creating another lease
post.description: Break-glass emergency repair. Requires separate short-lived break_glass role, reason, incident reference, and risk acknowledgement. Never issues claim tokens or deletes audit.

ClaimTokenHeader.name: X-Queue-Claim-Token
ClaimTokenHeader.description: Secret claim capability token. Required together with WorkerBearer on lease mutations (logical AND).

JsonValue.description: Recursive JSON value; no business properties declared.

Error.description: Production error envelope. retry_after_ms is optional. Skeleton-only code skeleton_operation_unsupported is excluded from production ErrorCode.

long_polling.description: True when the deployment claim wait ceiling is positive; false when claim_max_wait_seconds is 0 (long polling disabled).

max_wait_seconds.description: Exact deployment claim wait ceiling in seconds (0..20). Equals 0 when long polling is disabled.

Capabilities.description: Protocol advertisement. ADR017 defaults: enqueue dedup 90 days (7776000s), terminal replay 7 days (604800s), admin replay 30 days (2592000s).

ClaimGrant.description: Claim grant with secret claim_token; only on claim responses.

priority.description: Signed task priority. Higher numeric value is preferred among due candidates when priority scheduling is active. Values are not named bands.
Signed task priority. Higher numeric value is preferred among due candidates when priority scheduling is active. Values are not named bands.

available_at.description: Timezone-aware RFC3339 instant. Omitted or null means Queue-store now at commit time. Past or current instants run immediately. Future instants within the deployment scheduling horizon (QUEUE_SCHEDULE_HORIZON_SECONDS, default 86400 seconds) are delayed until due. Naive timestamps and values beyond the horizon reject with validation_failed.

EnqueueTaskRequest.description: Enqueue body. Idempotency-Key header required. Replay guaranteed 90 days (ADR017); expired key may create a new task.
